correction.reason: A valid entry is defined as an executable tick at or before session_close_timestamp; if no stop occurs that same entry tick is necessarily at least one eligible same-day exit quote. Therefore NO_SAME_DAY_EXIT_TICK cannot occur after a valid entry under the frozen semantics.

purpose: Freeze the non-economic execution-normalization interface and independent parity requirements between frozen GA1 semantic masks and the already validated statistical scorer, without inventing runtime-local mask encoding or reading economic PnL.

layer_boundaries.semantic_rematerialization: Produces canonical event identity from frozen signal logic; production must reproduce frozen class count, semantic root and alias root without inventing raw mask encoding.
layer_boundaries.execution_normalizer: Consumes explicit event anchors and ordered Bid/Ask ticks, applies execution only and emits normalized anchored trades.
layer_boundaries.statistical_scorer: Validated W09 component; immutable under W09B.

frozen_execution_semantics.signal_observability: signal_observable_timestamp <= entry_trigger_timestamp; fill first ordered executable tick at or after trigger and at or before session close
frozen_execution_semantics.stop_fill: first exit-side quote crossing fixed stop; adverse gaps fill at actual first executable quote
frozen_execution_semantics.same_day_fill: last executable exit-side quote at or before exact session_close_timestamp
frozen_execution_semantics.tick_order: strictly increasing carrier_sequence; nondecreasing timestamp; equal timestamps allowed

event_anchor_contract.production_origin_requirement: anchors must come from frozen semantic rematerializer + exact broker/session authority; normalizer may not synthesize missing anchors
event_anchor_contract.synthetic_fixture_rule: isolated explicit anchors allowed solely for non-economic execution testing

synthetic_execution_fixture_contract.why_isolated: same-candidate overlapping-signal admission is not yet durably bound

production_rematerialization_contract.runtime_data_absence: BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE only at production bundle materialization
